intro_subtitle: Let me just start from the beginning...

cafe_shifts.text: I worked closing shifts at a café until 9:30 PM and took the bus everywhere because I couldn't afford a car.

cramped_apartment.text: My roommate was always late on rent in our cramped apartment, and I vented most nights to Claire.

daniel_regular.text: Daniel worked late nearby and stopped in at 9:15 for hot chocolate. We knew each other from small talk at the counter.

missed_last_bus.text: One freezing, rainy night, closing ran ten minutes late and I missed the last bus with no cash for a cab.

first_ride_home.text: Daniel pulled out of the lot, saw me shivering under the streetlight, and offered a ride since it was on his way.

night_pickups.text: He started showing up at 9:25 with hot chocolate in the cupholder so I wouldn't freeze at the bus stop.

outgoing.weekend_hugs: Everything felt so easy back then. Like someone was finally looking out for me.

insisted_on_rides.text: When I told him I wanted to walk or take the bus, he wouldn't leave the lot until I got in the car.

weekend_hugs.text: We started spending weekends together. He always met me at the door with a long, warm hug.

outgoing.quit_cafe_rest: Wait... how was I paying rent if I hadn't moved in yet?

moved_in_together.text: When my roommate moved out and rent spiked, Daniel offered to let me move into his apartment.

no_rent_insistence.text: Even when I offered to split costs, he insisted I didn't need to pay a dime of rent.

quit_cafe_rest.text: I quit those exhausting late shifts at the café, and Daniel covered the bills without hesitation so I could finally rest.

pushed_to_quit.text: He kept pushing me to quit the café, saying it was ridiculous for me to work nights when he could pay for everything.

stuck_alone_indoors.text: With no job and no car, I spent most of my days alone inside his apartment.

drifted_from_claire.text: Life got busy, and Claire and I slowly lost touch.

outgoing.moved_out_of_town: Those months are kind of a blur...

called_claire_toxic.text: Daniel kept calling Claire toxic and draining until I agreed out loud that I was better off without her.

reading_my_texts.text: He was reading my texts over my shoulder and questioning why I replied to anyone.

blocked_bedroom_door.text: When I tried to go out anyway, he blocked the bedroom door until I apologized for being ungrateful.

warm_after_canceling.text: The moment I canceled my plans and said sorry, he turned warm again.

outgoing.owed_him_sex: I really don't want to think about this...

owed_him_sex.text: Sex became something he was treating like I owed him.

pinned_and_bruised.text: When I said I was tired or pushed him off, he pinned my wrists and gripped my arms until they bruised.

stopped_fighting_bed.text: He didn't stop until I quit fighting and just lay still on the bed.

hot_chocolate_in_bed.text: He brought hot chocolate to bed, stroked my hair, and said he only did it out of love.

moved_out_of_town.text: To get out of the city noise, we moved into a quieter apartment further out of town.

no_bus_only_his_car.text: Out there, there were no bus lines and only his car, so if I wanted to leave, Daniel had to drive me.

phone_repair_offer.text: When my phone broke, Daniel took it to a repair shop so I wouldn't have to worry.

outgoing.two_days_to_fix: Two days for a cracked screen... I never even questioned why it took so long.

two_days_to_fix.text: It took him two whole days to "get it fixed."

secret_job_apply.text: I secretly applied for a part-time job on my phone while he was at work.

found_out_yelled.text: Daniel found out about the application without me telling him. He yelled that I didn't trust him and refused to drive me.

withdrew_apologized.text: I withdrew the application and apologized, feeling guilty for being ungrateful after all he'd done.

restaurant_proposal.text: He took me out to an expensive restaurant and got down on one knee with a ring. Of course I said yes.

outgoing.forced_yes_in_public: What else would I have done?

forced_yes_in_public.text: The restaurant was packed and every table was watching when he asked. I forced myself to say yes in front of them.

city_parents_dinner.text: We drove back into the city for dinner with his parents and stopped at a store for wine and flowers.

outgoing.restaurant_proposal: No, wait... I was already wearing the ring at that dinner.

claire_grocery_runin.text: Inside the grocery store, we ran into Claire. She asked why I texted months ago to end our friendship.

never_sent_that_text.text: My stomach dropped because I never sent that text. Daniel smiled and told her I was just overwhelmed with wedding planning.

fingers_digging_side.text: His arm wrapped around my waist, fingers digging into my side to keep me quiet.

claire_saw_bruises.text: Through my sleeve, I saw Claire staring down at the faded bruises on my wrist.

acted_normal_drive.text: On the drive back to the apartment, Daniel acted like nothing had happened.

counter_mugs_hug.text: He set two mugs of hot chocolate on the counter and pulled me into a hug.

bitter_sip_stomach.text: Slipping out of his arms, I took a sip, and the sweet chocolate tasted so bitter my stomach turned.

awake_left_morning.text: I lay awake all night. Once he left for work, I packed a bag and called Claire from the main road.

river_walk_call.text: While Claire and I walk along the river near her place, Daniel calls.

always_know_where.text: His calm act vanishes: "I know you called Claire. I always know where you are."

threw_phone_in_river.text: I tell him to go to hell, hang up, and throw the phone straight into the river so he can never trace me.
